Counsel for Applicant :- Syed Ali Imam,Ahmad Saeed,Alok Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A., 
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 09 of 2021 under Sections 376, 506 IPC, Police Station Sihani Gate, District Ghaziabad, with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
Victim is a major and married lady.

She has lodged F.I.R. on 3.1.2021 alleging the applicant on 22.1.2021 at 4.30 p.m., while her husband was not at home, applicant came at her house and forcibly established physical relationship with her.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that alleged incident has been shown at 4.30 p.m. but there is nothing to show Rizwan vs State Of Uttar Pradesh on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184149402/

sentences.text: that victim has raised any alarm.
Victim has not sustained any injury.
The F.I.R. has been lodged on the next day.
As per prosecution version, applicant was friend of husband of victim.

Learned counsel for the applicant has referred the statement of victim and submitted that the attending facts clearly show that victim had been a consenting party and she has lodged F.I.R. on the next day with malafide intention.
Further, the D.N.A. report also does not support the prosecution version.
The criminal history of four minor cases shown against the applicant has been duly explained in the supplementary affidavit.
Lastly it was submitted that applicant accused is languishing in jail since 10.2.2021 but not a single witness has been examined so far.

4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the application and submitted that victim has made clear allegation that applicant came her house and committed rape upon her and there are no reasons of false implication of the applicant.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, the period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Rizwan, involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.
Order Date :- 16.1.2024
Kumar Manish.
